source_script.description: Required bundled Lua source module implementing this extension's behavior (export contract documented in extensions/format/source-script-format.md). Must match the canonical module for id: sources/<lang>/<name>.

adapter.description: Optional legacy bundled KOReader adapter. New sources should implement source_script directly; adapters remain for compatibility while scripts are migrated.

theme.description: optional: name of a shared theme this extension is based on, resolved against extensions/themes/<theme>.tkext.json for defaults this file overrides

endpoints.description: URL templates. {page}, {query}, {manga_url}, {chapter_url} are substituted at request time. {query} is percent-encoded automatically.

selectors.description: CSS selectors evaluated via KOReader's bundled htmlparser (common/htmlparser.lua) -- real tag/.class/#id/[attr]/[attr=val] support plus descendant/child combinators, see htmlparser's ElementNode:select() grammar. Each value is either a bare selector string (text content is extracted) or a {sel, attr, fallback_attr?} object (an attribute is extracted instead). sel: 'self' (or omitting sel) means read the attribute directly off the matched list-item node itself, for sites whose list-item selector already IS the link element.

date_format.description: strptime-compatible pattern for chapter_date text, or 'relative' for '3 days ago' style strings

form_body.description: for POST endpoints (e.g. WordPress admin-ajax): static key/value pairs merged with {page}/{query} substitutions
